public_source: Existing inspected upstream-codex-20261105/reuse-map.json pinned c90354172c5c49535b122443e9a8ed52c2233b80. Inspected public scope does not establish native Chat composer layout.

observations.conclusion: contents and attachmentItems are separate fields; audioAttachments, pendingVideoThumbnails, selectVideo and onExpand are also separately represented. Metadata alone does not prove active branches.
Grid fields include sourceItems, userRole, contentAlignment, cornerRadius, attachmentStyle, attachmentAccessory and attachmentSize. Their concrete values and call-site overrides remain unknown.
User part body witness0x3ae7884 branches to0x3ae6920. The retained code window contains several functions. Full content/attachment construction and parent layout are unresolved.

host_gap: Chat composer plus invoked NativeLibraryHost only. DraftStore, StoredTurn and ChatMessageService had no attachment references, so selecting a library item could not submit or project it in a user message.
independent_integration: Add bounded ChatAttachment references to scoped drafts and persisted turns, preserving old snapshots with missing fields. Retry must preserve attachment identity.

Use existing LocalLibraryStore for bounded account-scoped copies. Selection callbacks require scope and generation, partial imports roll back. Removal preserves bytes referenced by another draft or history.
Add explicit service capability and attachment request overload. Fixture records references without reading contents or executing models. Legacy adapter rejects nonempty attachments.

Connect system Files picker, pending file controls, attachment-only send, retry, native QuickLook preview and return. A test-only flag injects synthetic picker results through the same import boundary.
File chips, file-only message cards, dimensions, colors, local file budgets and native preview integration are independent host decisions. Photos, video and official grid/menu geometry remain open.
Commit local turn history before clearing the draft. Failed history write keeps the draft and prevents submission.

failed_probes.reason: new test used chat-a instead of the catalog backend identity; corrected test input. Retained ios-chat-v572-state-r1-invalid-test-identity.log.

limitations: Official composer picker/menu/thumbnail geometry and transfer lifecycle remain unresolved. No claim of source-equivalent attachment rendering.
System Files selection success is exercised through a deterministic result fixture; actual system cancellation is a separate UI test.
Photo picker, image thumbnails, PDF/image/unsupported preview cases, upload progress and missing-resource recovery are pending.
Large message gaps and exact action/footer style remain open. Physical device, haptics, notifications and Android are independently unaccepted.
shared_boundary: ChatAttachment, scoped persistence and service action tests are independent shareable frontend contracts. System picker, QuickLook, IME and geometry remain iOS adapters; no Android equivalence established.
